summary: Generic clone capability call wrote automatic checkpoint into live runtime directory
symptom: A disposable clone warp replaced runtime/session/auto-forward-latest.state and metadata with clone map 29:11

unexpected.predicted: All clone emulator and capability artifacts remain inside disposable temporary runtime storage
unexpected.actual: The clone emulator was isolated, but the capability subprocess inherited the live MGBA_RUNTIME_DIR default
diff: capability subprocess lacked an isolated MGBA_RUNTIME_DIR
extra_state_deltas: live auto-forward checkpoint and metadata were replaced by clone map 29:11; explicit live save repaired both

authority.oracle: SHA-256 of the ledger checkpoint and live auto-forward files, canonical RAM state hash, and returned clone auto-checkpoint path

steps: compare hashes and returned auto-checkpoint path
reproduction.observed: Static code path proved the child inherited the live runtime default; the pre-fix run wrote map 29:11 metadata under runtime/session

hypotheses.claim: The capability subprocess inherits the controller's live runtime directory rather than the clone launcher's temporary runtime
hypotheses.predicted_discriminator: setting MGBA_RUNTIME_DIR for the child moves auto-forward output to a temporary path without changing live hashes
hypotheses.evidence_for: fixed replay returned /private/.../runbun-call-.../auto-forward-latest.state.meta.json and all three protected hashes remained identical

root_cause.claim: runbun_call changed only MGBA_RPC_PORT for clone calls; runbun_mcp therefore used the default live runtime directory for capability auto-checkpoints
evidence: post-fix result named a runbun-call temporary directory
alternatives_falsified: clone emulator isolation failure: the clone listened on its unique port and live RAM never moved

solution.contract_change: --clone-state now gives both the emulator and capability subprocess disposable runtime storage

targeted_checks.name: clone runtime routing
targeted_checks.evidence: 1 test passed; child receives clone port and MGBA_RUNTIME_DIR

regression_checks.name: protected hash replay
regression_checks.command: fixed clone warp followed by shasum of live auto-forward and ledger checkpoint

replay.expected: Clone auto-checkpoint is temporary and live hashes remain unchanged
replay.actual: Both clone auto-checkpoints were under separate /private/.../runbun-call-* directories and live hashes were unchanged

regression_cases: generic capability write in disposable clone must not use live runtime directory
tooling_contracts: --clone-state isolates RPC port, emulator runtime, and capability artifact runtime
